title: At the swimming pool
instructions: Ella yüzme havuzunda bilgi alıyor. Fiyatlar, saatler ve kurallara dikkat et.

script.speaker: ella
script.text: Hello. How much is it to swim?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: It's four pounds for adults and two pounds for children.

script.speaker: ella
script.text: One adult and one child, please. My son is eight.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: That's six pounds. Do you have swimming caps?

script.speaker: ella
script.text: No, we don't. Do we need them?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Yes, you do. They are one pound each.

script.speaker: ella
script.text: OK, two caps, please. What time does the pool close?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: At nine o'clock. But children can only swim until seven.

questions.prompt: How much is it for a child?
questions.feedback: Çocuklar için iki pound (two pounds); yetişkinler dört.

questions.prompt: What do they need to buy?
questions.feedback: Bone zorunlu; iki bone (two caps) alıyorlar.

questions.prompt: Until what time can children swim?
questions.feedback: Havuz dokuzda kapanıyor ama çocuklar yediye kadar (until seven) yüzebilir.
questions.evidence: But children can only swim until seven.
